[Fortnite](https://www.turtlebeach.com/blog/category/guides?tag=Fortnite) and The Simpsons have teamed up to release a brand new mini-season for players; and it looks incredible.


With any new season also comes a new Battle Pass, and although it's a mini-one, we're still going to run over all of the pages.


Here's what we know.


## Fortnite The Simpsons Battle Pass: All Pages, Skins, and More


The brand new Fortnite season has implemented a ton of content for players to sink their teeth into, and adventuring through Springfield has been a joy.


There are some iconic skins in this season's Battle Pass, as with The Simpsons-themed season, Homer and Marge are both obtainable in-game now.
